messages:
marie.support: FYI customer Innotech reports assistant answers became noticeably shorter after last night's model push (redwood-v5.3.1). They say responses feel 'clipped' and lose helpful elaboration. They pasted one before/after example:

marie.support: Customer prompt: `How do I set up SSO with Okta for our app? Step-by-step please.`

marie.support: Before (v5.3.0):
```
Sure — here’s a step-by-step outline:
1) Create an Okta app integration (OIDC).
2) Configure redirect URIs in both Okta and your app.
3) Exchange client creds for tokens using the /token endpoint.
4) Validate ID tokens and map Okta groups to roles.
5) Test end-to-end and enable provisioning.
Let me know which framework you use and I can give code samples.
```

marie.support: After (v5.3.1):
```
Create Okta OIDC app, set redirect URI, exchange tokens, validate ID token. Test.
```

marie.support: Customer says the shorter reply is breaking their UX (users click away expecting full steps). They included our request/response payloads — copied below.

cleo.support: Can you paste the exact API payload we sent and the headers (model param overrides)? Also, did they set any client-side max_tokens or stop sequences?

marie.support: Pasted from their support thread (redacted keys):
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
{
  "model": "redwood-v5.3.1",
  "input": "How do I set up SSO with Okta for our app? Step-by-step please.",
  "max_tokens": 150,
  "temperature": 0.2
}
```

anil.ml: Quick hypotheses: 1) v5.3.1 changed default length bias / length_penalty or introduced a brevity bias in decoding. 2) rollout included a different decoding profile/params (e.g., min_length or stop tokens). 3) quantization/compiled kernel change altered tokenization or EOS detection.

anil.ml: I’ll pull the model config and rollout metadata. Please try forcing explicit generation params (min_tokens, length_penalty) to see if we can override client-side.

marie.support: Repro attempted (I ran this from my laptop to reproduce exactly):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v5.3.1","input":"How do I set up SSO with Okta for our app? Step-by-step please.","max_tokens":150,"temperature":0.2}'
```

marie.support: Response we saw:
```
{"id":"req_01F8...","output":["Create Okta OIDC app, set redirect URI, exchange tokens, validate ID token. Test."],"meta":{"latency_ms":120,"tokens":18}}
```

sophie.prod: We rolled redwood-v5.3.1 to 100% at 2026-02-18T03:12Z (rollout id r-20260218-53). Canary at 5% earlier in the evening showed no automated alerts but we didn't have a prompt-specific QA sweep for SSO/how-to style prompts.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment redwood-v5.3.1 finished r-20260218-53 -> service: inference (100%).

anil.ml: For a quick workaround, try forcing these params in the request: `min_tokens: 80`, `length_penalty: -0.5` (or `penalty: -0.3` depending on API name), and `top_p: 0.95`. Example to force longer output:
```
{"model":"redwood-v5.3.1","input":"How do I set up SSO...","max_tokens":250,"min_tokens":80,"length_penalty":-0.5,"temperature":0.2}
```

anil.ml: I’ll diff v5.3.0 vs v5.3.1 generation defaults and check the model weights change log for any intentional brevity tweaks.

cleo.support: I’ll draft customer reply with a short workaround snippet and offer to roll them back to v5.3.0 if they prefer. Also asking CS to capture a few more before/after examples for different prompt types (how-to, explainers, step lists).

marie.support: Created support ticket INC-2026-1023 with customer repro. CS has asked for a temporary rollback option.

sophie.prod: Please pause any further progressive rollouts until we confirm root cause. If we see config drift, we can back out r-20260218-53 to 5.3.0. I'll open a rollback request.

anil.ml: Action items I’ll take now: 1) Check generation-defaults and config baked into v5.3.1. 2) Run local offline eval with canonical how-to prompt set to measure average length delta. 3) If it's config-related, provide a hotfix with old defaults or an explicit param override.

cleo.support: Thanks — I’ll let Innotech know we’re investigating and provide the generated workaround. Will escalate to account exec if they request rollback.

marie.support: Pinged account team and attached the exact request/response. Will update thread with any quick repro metrics. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-1023 created (priority: high, owner: cleo.support).
